__note: Reviewed rename worklist for darths-rage (PLAN §5 campaign). RAGE's inline script is AUTHORED, not minified: of the 312 chunk-scope (IIFE-body) bindings, 266 already carry the author's own semantic names (renderer, scene, camera, player, crates, audioInit, …) and are left untouched — renaming them would destroy the author's naming, not recover it. This worklist renames only the 46 genuinely opaque short bindings (utility aliases, scratch vectors/quaternions/matrices, level-constant abbreviations, state objects). Every rule is evidence-based: the comment names the declaration this rule was authored from (line numbers refer to readable/index-inline-1.pretty.js at the 2026-10-13 capture). Targets must not collide with an existing chunk-scope binding or a free/global name; tools/apply-names.mjs refuses collisions, shorthand positions, and chained renames, and tools/verify-rename.mjs + tools/check-chunk.mjs prove the result.
